nyanlex.ui.about.s1.title: What can be translated
nyanlex.ui.about.s1.body: Chat, item tooltips, scoreboards, name tags, boss bars, titles, the action bar, books and screen text can all be translated. In the Display category each one can be set to off, bilingual (original plus translation) or translation only. To actually send anything, first turn on "Send translation requests" in General (off by default).
nyanlex.ui.about.s2.title: Quick switches
nyanlex.ui.about.s2.body: The Display category has one row per item with two buttons: the left one cycles Off, bilingual, translation on every click; the right one switches between machine translation and AI. The two rows at the top set everything at once.
nyanlex.ui.about.s3.title: Machine translation and AI
nyanlex.ui.about.s3.body: Machine translation (Google) is fast and needs no setup. AI translation is better but needs an API key or a ChatGPT sign-in in the AI & machine category.
nyanlex.ui.about.s4.title: Items and screen text
nyanlex.ui.about.s4.body: Items (tooltips, held item name, container and hotbar item names) and mod screen text follow the engine you pick for them: with AI they translate automatically like chat; with machine translation they switch to manual so joining a server never floods it with requests, and anything already translated keeps showing. On machine translation press R to translate the item you hold or point at, P to translate the whole screen (it uses the engine of Screen in the Display category) and G to toggle original and translation.
nyanlex.ui.about.s5.title: Warm all items
nyanlex.ui.about.s5.body: In the Requests category you can translate every item name and description in one go. It works from the title screen, no world needed; a few mod items need a world to build their tooltip, are skipped and counted, and a second run inside a world fills them in. Needs the AI engine and "Send translation requests" turned on, and sends many requests.
nyanlex.ui.about.s6.title: Request cooldown and batching
nyanlex.ui.about.s6.body: Cooldown and batch collection avoid sending too many requests in a short time, which could get you rate-limited.
nyanlex.ui.about.s7.title: Do-not-translate terms
nyanlex.ui.about.s7.body: Terms you list are kept untranslated forever, for example a server name.
nyanlex.ui.about.s8.title: Export and import
nyanlex.ui.about.s8.body: Export writes your translations to a file for backup; import loads a file you were given. Import only adds missing entries and never overwrites existing translations.
nyanlex.ui.about.s9.title: Master switch and hub
nyanlex.ui.about.s9.body: "Send translation requests" in General is the master switch and is off by default; while off, no new request is sent and cached text keeps showing. The Hub category detects translation packs on the GitHub translation hub for your current server and installed mods, lists them with sizes, and downloads only after you confirm.
nyanlex.ui.privacy.title: Privacy
nyanlex.ui.privacy.body: "Send translation requests" is off by default and nothing is sent. Once you turn it on, each item sends its game text (including chat, which may contain private messages and player names) to the translation service you chose: machine translation defaults to Google's keyless, unofficial endpoint; AI goes to the service you configured. Your API key stays in the local config file only. The hub only downloads public files and uploads nothing. See About for details.
nyanlex.ui.about.s10.title: Privacy: what is sent
nyanlex.ui.about.s10.body: "Send translation requests" is off by default and nothing is sent (manual R, P and warm-up included). Once it is on, only items set to bilingual or translation send text, and what is sent is the text shown there: chat (possibly private messages and player names), item names and descriptions, scoreboards, name tags and holograms, boss bars, titles, the action bar, book pages, menu and mod screen text. An item set to Off sends nothing. Machine translation defaults to Google's keyless, unofficial endpoint; AI sends to the service you set up in the AI & machine category.
nyanlex.ui.about.s11.title: Privacy: local data
nyanlex.ui.about.s11.body: Your API key lives only in the local config file and is used only to sign in to the AI service you picked. Translations are cached on your computer. The GitHub translation hub only downloads public files and never uploads any local data; you confirm every download.

screen.nyanlex.warmup.title: Item Warm-up
screen.nyanlex.warmup.unavailable.engine: Item warm-up only works with the AI engine for item tooltips (Settings > Item surface set to AI). Under machine translation, items are translated manually with the R key, so there is nothing to pre-warm.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.summary: Items: %s, already cached: %s, still to translate: %s
screen.nyanlex.warmup.nothing: Everything is already cached. Nothing to do.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.estimate: This launch: %s items, about %s requests, about %s tokens (estimate)
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.1: Sends the name and full tooltip of every registered item to the AI in the background, at the lowest priority. Items already in the cache are skipped.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.2: This uses your AI API quota and may cost money. Free tiers may hit 429 rate limits, and a 429 also pauses chat and tooltip translation for a while (warm-up pauses itself when rate limited).
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.3: Only items registered by mods are covered. It does nothing for Hypixel and other server-made items; it is meant for modpacks.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.4: You can pause or stop at any time. It resumes by itself next launch and skips what is already cached.
